name: Toploong F2100K
description: Fangling F2100K v5.0 (Toploong 1325). Output matches the format cut daily on the owner's machine via SheetCAM 'Toploong Koike simple' and Autodesk FangLing posts (see docs/reference/). No spaces inside blocks, +sign forced, 4 decimals, .txt. No Z, no F — THC and cut chart live on the controller. G41/G42 not emitted; kerf comp is done in software.
base: SheetCAM 'Toploong Koike simple' / Autodesk FangLing F2100K
